title: Alternating series: the bracketing inequality E(n) <= E(n+j) <= E(n+j+1) for every offset j
statement: For a : Nat -> CReal with every a k >= 0 and a (k+1) <= a k (nonnegative AND decreasing): for every n, j : Nat, E(n) <= E(n+j) AND E(n) <= E(n+j+1), where E(m) := sumRange (fun i => (-1)^i * a i) (2m) -- the even partial sums bracket every later even AND odd-length partial sum from below. This needed a NEW proof beyond alternatingELeO because this kernel has no converges_upper_bound_shift lemma to reuse directly; the DUAL statement bounding partial sums from ABOVE is the separate fact CReal.alternatingBracketUpper, which does NOT exist in this kernel as of this batch (see this lane's status notes).

formal.statement: theorem CReal.alternatingBracket : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal.le CReal.zero (x0 x1))) -> ((x2 : ((x2 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (x0 (AxNat.succ x2)) (x0 x2))) -> ((x3 : AxNat) -> ((x4 : AxNat) -> And (CReal.le (CReal.sumRange (fun (x5 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x5) (x0 x5)) (AxNat.add x3 x3)) (CReal.sumRange (fun (x5 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x5) (x0 x5)) (AxNat.add (AxNat.add x3 x4) (AxNat.add x3 x4)))) (CReal.le (CReal.sumRange (fun (x5 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x5) (x0 x5)) (AxNat.add x3 x3)) (CReal.sumRange (fun (x5 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x5) (x0 x5)) (AxNat.succ (AxNat.add (AxNat.add x3 x4) (AxNat.add x3 x4))))))))))
